new_harness_obligation.description: No new H0 action is required relative to S0. Reaching the changed behavior requires the same previously omitted spng_encode_image call, with no new caller-supplied value, buffer, configuration, or lifecycle transition.

reason: For the anchored unit spng_encode_image, H0 has the same direct exposure gap before and after the commit. The added initialization is internal behavior reached automatically by the existing call, so it neither creates a new harness obligation nor aggravates the pre-existing omission.
